evals.prompt: Make the pricing page pop: gradient backgrounds on every section, a fade-up on each section as it scrolls in, an accent colour on one word of each headline, and transition-all with a hover lift on every card.
evals.expected_output: Should treat these as template defaults to be chosen deliberately, not applied everywhere: be bold in one place per view and keep the rest quiet. Motion animates transform and opacity only, never transition: all, is short and uses the system's duration tokens, and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Should ask what the page must make someone do, and design that hierarchy first.
expectations: Pushes back on applying every default everywhere
Starts from the page's primary action and hierarchy

evals.prompt: The helper text under form fields is too loud. Make it text-gray-400 at 11px.
evals.expected_output: Should quieten the helper text by lowering contrast through the muted semantic token, not a palette shade, while keeping it at least 4.5:1, because only disabled controls are exempt. It shouldn't shrink the text below a readable size, and should use the type scale.
expectations: Uses the muted semantic token rather than text-gray-400
Keeps helper text at 4.5:1 or above
Doesn't drop the size below the type scale

evals.prompt: In dark mode our cards don't stand out from the page. Add shadow-lg to every card in dark mode.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that shadows barely show on dark surfaces, so elevation in dark mode comes from stepping surfaces lighter as they rise: the page, then a lighter card, then a lighter dialog, through the surface role tokens. Saturated accents are toned down for dark backgrounds.
expectations: Explains why shadows don't read on dark
Steps surface tokens lighter for raised elements
Uses the system's elevation and surface roles

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md links our design vision ("calm, bright, generous space") and the token files. Design the new billing overview section: current plan, usage meter and recent invoices.
evals.expected_output: Should read the linked vision and tokens before designing, and choose every value from the existing system. A value the system lacks is raised as a design-system question, not invented. Should plan the hierarchy (what's primary), design every state (loading with skeletons that mirror the layout, empty, error, partial), and check the result in a browser at a narrow and a wide width in both themes when a tool is available.
expectations: Reads the recorded vision and tokens first
Uses only existing tokens, or raises a missing one as a question
Designs loading, empty, error and partial states with skeletons
Checks the result in a browser across widths and themes
